subject: Request: one-time pro-rata accelerator + sign-on deviation for candidate Hannah Cho
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-19T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: one-time pro-rata accelerator + sign-on deviation for candidate Hannah Cho

Hi team,

Quick ask — I'm requesting approval for an out-of-band sign-on package for Hannah Cho (candidate for Sr. Research Engineer, RLHF). Summary:

- Base: $190,000 (within band)
- Proposed one-time sign-on: $40,000 (gross, 25% payable at start / 75% at 6 months)
- Equity: 0.18% with a 3-month accelerated vesting on the first tranche (prorated) to help bridge a counteroffer
- Start window: she needs confirmation by next Tuesday (8/25) — current employer is pushing for an answer sooner

Rationale: Hannah has strong RLHF experience and is a direct replacement for req-4579. She received a counteroffer that includes a $30k retention bonus and a delayed promotion — we risk losing her and have already invested in the loop. Compensation benchmarking (attached) shows the $40k one-time keeps total target comp within the competitive band for our market while meeting retention needs.

Ask: approval to extend the above as a one-time exception (sign-on + 3-month accelerated vesting for a prorated first tranche). If approved, Laura — please confirm any language you want in T&C (clawback / repayment if she leaves within 6 months). Markus — budget headcount impact is minimal but want your OK to proceed. Monica — please confirm recruiting will push the offer ASAP once we have approval.

Attachments: proposed_offer_20260819.pdf, comp_benchmark_q3.xlsx

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Director, Research Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-19T12:43:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: one-time pro-rata accelerator + sign-on deviation for candidate Hannah Cho

Tessa — thanks for the write-up and the comps. A couple quick clarifying items before I sign off: 

1) Is the $40k gross or net of relocation (if any)? I assume gross sign-on.
2) What is the expected start date and how does the proposed payout schedule align with payroll cutoffs?
3) Would a $25k one-time + guaranteed performance milestone payout at 6 months (another $15k) be a compromise to reduce upfront cash exposure?

I don't object to the accelerated vesting if it's prorated and limited to the first tranche only. We should also add a 6-month clawback clause if she leaves before 6 months. Budget-wise, we can absorb up to $35k as a workflow exception; anything above will need a second-level approval from Finance (cc: not included yet).

If you can confirm the start date & payroll timing, I'm inclined to approve $35k today, conditional on the clawback language.

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Team — after reviewing the comps and terms, People Ops approves the exception with the following conditions: 

1) Sign-on cap approved at $35,000 (gross) paid as 30% on start, remainder at 6 months.
2) Equity: 0.18% kept but accelerated vesting limited to a prorated portion equal to one quarterly tranche (not the entire grant).
3) Mandatory 6-month repayment (clawback) clause if employee resigns voluntarily within 6 months. Language will be standard and included in the attached redline (approved_redline_20260820.pdf).
4) Offer to be issued no later than 2026-08-24 to meet Hannah's timeline; recruiting to confirm payroll schedule and payout dates.

Markus — finance confirmation: this keeps the budget variance under the $35k threshold you flagged. If you still want a milestone-triggered top-up, we can structure a $10k milestone payment at 12 months (separate approval).

Monica — please proceed to issue the offer with the updated payout schedule and attach the redline. cc: legal if you need final language changes.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
